# Rule factory test fixtures

- `CVE-2022-26134.yaml`, `CVE-2021-44228.yaml`: Nuclei templates from
  [projectdiscovery/nuclei-templates](https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei-templates),
  MIT licence, copied unchanged so the drafting tests run offline.
- `upload-template.yaml`: written for these tests. It describes a made-up
  file-upload flaw under the reserved, fictional id CVE-2099-0001.
- `kev-sample.json`: four entries in the format of CISA's Known Exploited
  Vulnerabilities feed, shortened.
